name: fitness-and-goal-tracker
description: Fitness and Goal Tracker - Personal App for Namineni Rakhesh

scripts.build: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (!fs.existsSync('dist')) fs.mkdirSync('dist', { recursive: true }); ['index.html', 'today.html', 'closeout.html', 'screen.png', 'favicon.png', 'favicon.ico'].forEach(f => { if (fs.existsSync(f)) fs.copyFileSync(f, 'dist/' + f); }); if (fs.existsSync('public')) { if (!fs.existsSync('dist/public')) fs.mkdirSync('dist/public', { recursive: true }); fs.cpSync('public', 'dist/public', { recursive: true }); } console.log('Build completed: dist/ ready for Capacitor');"
